newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee seen in range with upside potential.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee seen in range with upside potential.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE coffee futures were seen mostly in a range in the near-term, but analysts said they could see some upward potential with help from soaring New York arabicas.
CSCE July arabica closed 5.05 cents per pound higher on Wednesday, which should help July robustas here open $10 higher at the start.
Sucden analyst Adrian Haylor said July robusta still looked trapped in a near-term range between support at $1,630 and a gap starting at Monday's high of $1,705 and the March 12 low of $1,730.
But further out in the next couple of weeks to a month, he expected July to resume its uptrend with help from New York's strength.
CSCE gains pulled LIFFE coffee out of negative ground on Wednesday afternoon to end up $7 at $1,662 per tonne, just off its session high of $1,670.

But analysts who were not as optimistic were concerned about robusta's ability to sustain gains above stiff resistance at $1,700. They saw Monday's high of $1,705 as a test and failure because July had slipped again to close below $1,700 that day.
